summary: First-ever test pass for Portable Personal AI Computer dashboard. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passed covering system status/stats, desktop endpoints (503 graceful), GitHub (branch/commits real, push/pull/sync return 400 not-configured), and full backup CRUD lifecycle (create/list/restore/restore-404/delete) against real filesystem tar operations. Frontend: All panels render in B&W monochrome, header shows DOCKER UNAVAILABLE badge, container status UNAVAILABLE, start/stop/restart show docker-unavailable toast, Open Desktop and Open Terminal modals open/close cleanly, telemetry gauges show real host CPU/RAM/Disk (36%/47%/17% - non-zero), GitHub panel shows branch=main + Initial commit from real /app repo, push button shows 'GitHub not configured' toast, Create Snapshot creates real tar.gz appearing in snapshot-list, Restore flow works end-to-end with success toast. All 'unavailable' states are honest (not fake data) as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: docker_manager.get_stats reads container.stats(stream=False) synchronously inside an async endpoint (/api/system/stats) - could block event loop for ~1s when docker is available; consider run_in_executor when Docker is available.
GitHubManager._env writes a temp askpass script per invocation - fine, but if push runs concurrently the temp files could collide by PID - acceptable given single-user dashboard.
backup_manager.restore_backup uses tar.extractall without member path sanitization - safe here (backups produced by same code) but Python 3.12+ warns; consider filter='data' for defense-in-depth.
seed_data_creation: Test backups created during pytest are cleaned up by the delete step in the same class. Cleaned up leftover UI-created snapshot from /app/data/backups and mongo backups collection after test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App works fully. Docker daemon absence is expected and handled gracefully by every code path. Real host telemetry via psutil works. Real git operations on /app repo work (branch/commits/status). Backup CRUD hits real filesystem. Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 19 tests). No test credentials needed (no auth).
